hypothesis: Add molecular-context guidance to the Parent's otherwise unchanged reverse diffusion. At every reverse step, run the same frozen denoiser on the current partially revealed target once with the selected evaluated context intact and once with only that context's molecular token positions padded out, then extrapolate the target logits from the weakened-context prediction toward the intact-context prediction at one fixed task-agnostic residual strength before applying the existing temperature, top-k sampling, and reveal schedule.
method_thesis: Train a task-agnostic bidirectional masked discrete-diffusion model on SAFE fragment sequences from the allowed unlabeled corpus, then keep its weights frozen during every objective session. Initialize a dynamic fragment vocabulary only from oracle-evaluated molecules, score each fragment by the observed rewards of molecules containing it, and construct each new starting context by sampling and attaching high-scoring fragments. Replace one complete fragment span with mask tokens and iteratively denoise that span in parallel while conditioning on the retained fragments; canonicalize locally and submit only newly generated valid unique molecules. Oracle feedback updates fragment scores and admits fragments from evaluated offspring, so the generator can repeatedly refine promising chemistry while its learned conditional denoising can synthesize fragments outside the current vocabulary. Every candidate is therefore generated de novo rather than retrieved or ranked from the corpus, and reward-directed fragment regeneration targets improvement of the final Top-1 within the sparse feedback budget.

activation_observables.measurement: For every unresolved target position at every reverse step of every completed remasking attempt, restrict all three distributions to the frozen molecular output alphabet and apply the plan's existing temperature. Let d be intact-context logits minus weakened-context logits, p_parent the softmax of the Parent's intact logits, and p_guided the softmax after the fixed residual extrapolation. Record E_p_guided[d] minus E_p_parent[d], then report its mean over positions, the number of paired positions, and the fraction with a positive value. The Parent reference is exactly 0.0 because p_guided equals p_parent when no context-contrast residual is applied; activation requires a positive aggregate amplification with traceable paired passes.
activation_observables.name: intact_context_guidance_contrast_amplification

applicability_conditions: The retained evaluated fragment carries useful conditional information for completing the masked replacement span, so intact and weakened predictions differ across the molecular output alphabet.
Reward-ranked context selection remains informative: amplifying an unproductive or spuriously high-scoring retained fragment can focus generation in the wrong direction.

Useful improvements can be reached while preserving more of one selected local context; transfer may weaken when the objective requires a replacement largely independent of that context or coordinated nonlocal changes across several spans.
The frozen denoiser tolerates interior context padding well enough that its paired weakened pass is a meaningful content ablation rather than a numerically unstable out-of-distribution input.
The second frozen forward pass fits within the objective-session timeout, and guided sampling retains enough valid novel yield to fill every announced batch within the unchanged local-attempt bound.
Evidence for the Parent is limited to screening seed 0, so activation and any score effect must not be generalized to multi-seed reliability without the protocol's later evaluation.
research_intent.falsifier: The mechanism did not happen if completed remasking attempts lack paired intact and molecular-context-padded predictions at the same target state and timestep, or if the aggregate intact_context_guidance_contrast_amplification is non-positive; either result means the emitted-token distribution was not shifted toward distinctions supplied by the intact selected context beyond the Parent's ordinary conditional logits.

At every reverse step, run the same frozen denoiser on the current partially revealed target once with the selected evaluated context intact and once with only that context's molecular token positions padded out, then extrapolate the target logits from the weakened-context prediction toward the intact-context prediction at one fixed task-agnostic residual strength before applying the existing temperature, top-k sampling, and reveal schedule.
research_intent.observed_bottleneck: Parent node n-697b8ab84a2a already gives evaluated high-reward fragments strong selection pressure (mean signed rank advantage 0.3460216677293582), traces every emitted molecule through retained-context whole-span denoising, reuses adaptively admitted fragments in every post-feedback round, and fills every batch with 0.4989676531314522 novel-valid remasking yield. Yet the objective signal affects reverse diffusion only by choosing the retained fragment: the frozen denoiser samples from ordinary intact-context logits without explicitly amplifying how that context changes the replacement distribution. With that mechanism active, terminal Top-1 improved by only 0.005072569757622 on median_2 and 0.010107822042211 on deco_hop, while 0.7441379310344828 of replacements were outside the evaluated dynamic vocabulary. The limiting behavior is therefore productive but weakly context-directed span innovation: many novel spans are generated, but the denoising distribution has no explicit pressure to preserve the conditional signal supplied by the selected high-reward context.

applicability_conditions: The evidence supports activation when intact retained context changes relative molecular-token logits: all 141,101 measured positions had strictly positive contrast amplification, across all five objectives and every suggestion round.

The inherited reward-ranked context selector remained active under guidance: all 145/145 candidate rounds had positive selected-context rank advantage, with round-level arithmetic mean 0.34039655305460287 over 5,667 non-tied draws. The activation evidence therefore concerns amplification of score-biased evaluated context rather than arbitrary context, but it does not prove that every selected fragment is productively aligned with the objective.

The paired padded-context pass was numerically and operationally tolerated under this compact frozen denoiser, strength 1.0, six-step schedule, batch size 10, and 300-call protocol: all 145 rounds produced finite measurements and filled their ten-molecule batch, yielding 1,450 emissions from 2,900 completed remasking attempts (0.5), and all five sessions finished with 300 oracle calls and zero evaluator-level invalid or duplicate attempts.

A positive score effect while preserving selected local context is supported only narrowly by deco_hop in this replica, whose final Top-1 was 0.004177807486631102 above the Parent. It is not supported on zaleplon_mpo, drd2_docking, median_2, or sitagliptin_mpo in seed 0, so transfer is weak when useful replacements are independent of the retained fragment, require coordinated nonlocal changes, or the selected context is spuriously high scoring.

The logs establish that interior context padding yields a stable contrast, not that the weakened sequence is semantically in-distribution. Applicability beyond this model and corpus requires a frozen denoiser that treats the PAD-only molecular-context ablation as meaningful rather than as an unsupported prefix pattern.
Evidence is limited to screening seed 0. It confirms paired-pass execution and the predicted intermediate distribution shift, not multi-seed reliability or a generally positive terminal-score effect.

observable_measurements.value: Seed 0 across five tasks: all 145/145 suggestion-round records, covering 2,900 completed fragment-remasking attempts, contain paired intact-context and molecular-context-padded predictions at the same reverse timestep and evolving target state. After restriction to the frozen molecular output alphabet and application of each plan's existing temperature, the records cover 141,101 paired unresolved target positions. The position-weighted mean of E_p_guided[d] minus E_p_parent[d] was 0.21688165399200912, and 141,101/141,101 paired positions had a positive value, for positive fraction 1.0. Every round aggregate was positive, ranging from 0.1366549402567157 to 0.3356110141606193. Position-weighted task means were deco_hop 0.25323452320558537 over 25,769 positions, drd2_docking 0.20833969018863416 over 32,829, median_2 0.23060256725265407 over 30,408, sitagliptin_mpo 0.2129217913125554 over 26,661, and zaleplon_mpo 0.17882218286688423 over 25,434; each task's positive-position fraction was 1.0. Thus the fixed-strength residual shifted the emitted-token distribution toward distinctions supplied by intact context in the preregistered direction on every measured position.

possible_failure_causes: The fixed positive residual amplifies every context-conditioned distinction, not specifically a reward-improving distinction. Although all 141,101 position effects were positive and reward-rank selection remained positive in all 145 candidate rounds, the seed-0 final Top-1 exceeded the Parent only on deco_hop (0.5626671122994653 versus 0.5584893048128342) and was lower on the other four tasks; the largest divergence was drd2_docking (0.06236729997125726 versus 0.9210446443023579). This is consistent with guidance over-preserving a selected local context when the productive edit is weakly tied to it, but this node does not isolate that explanation from single-seed sampling variation.

The molecular-context PAD pass was operationally finite and stable, but the evaluation contains no separate in-distribution ablation establishing that its residual isolates semantic context information rather than some response to an interior padded prefix. If that representation is out of the denoiser's training support, strength 1.0 can amplify an ablation artifact even while the registered contrast observable is positive.

Only screening seed 0 was evaluated. The paired distribution statistic decisively establishes activation for this replica, but the strongly heterogeneous task outcomes do not establish a generally useful guidance strength or multi-seed score reliability.
